outputs.explanation: Panel A consists of pseudocoloured micrograph images (photoactivation time-lapse), not a plot showing averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.

Panel B shows normalized intensity time courses as scatter plots where each point is an individual measurement over time (red/green data points) overlaid with the fitted model curves. The insets display averaged early time-point responses as line plots with error bars, a plot type exempt from requiring individual point overlays since doing so would make them unreadable. The main data already shows individual points, satisfying the check.
